items.label: IRS (mainland), simplified regime: 75% of service revenue is taxable

notes: Bracket limits are rounded; the specific deduction and IRS Jovem are not applied.

Coefficient 0.75 (CIRS art. 31): 15% of revenue must be justified with expenses; 4,104 EUR (or the social security paid, if higher) counts with no receipts, and what is still missing is added to the taxable profit.
Mainland rates: 23%, 13%, 6% (Madeira and the Azores are lower). IRS is progressive, and social security applies to self-employed income; 30% is a suggested reserve.

IRS 2027: the bracket limits rise 3.88% under the automatic annual update (portaria signed 12 October 2026): 8,666; 13,075; 18,530; 23,985; 30,538; 44,762; 48,373; 89,995. The rates are set in the 2027 State Budget, still in parliament; the estimate keeps the 2026 scale until then.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
